name: PicklePots
tagline: King of the Jar: a last-bidder-wins game on Pickle Chain testnet
valueNote: Pickle Chain testnet. Test ETH and test PKL only. Nothing here has real-world value and there is no mainnet deployment.

rules.twoOrMoreUniqueBidders: 90% to the last bidder, 5% seeds the next round, 5% protocol fee
rules.oneUniqueBidder: full refund, no fee, any seed rolls into the next round
rules.afterEachBid: deadline becomes bid time + extensionSeconds, never more than bid time + maxTimerSeconds
rules.settlement: The first bid after the deadline settles the old round and opens a new one (that bid counts in the new round). Anyone may also call finalizeRound(tier) once the deadline has passed and a leader exists.
rules.failedPayouts: Credited to pending[token][account]; withdraw with claim(token). Use address(0) for the native coin.

abi: function tierConfigs(uint256) view returns (string name, uint256 minBid, uint256 roundDuration, uint256 extensionTime, uint256 maxTimeCap, address token)

function getRound(uint8 tierId) view returns (uint256 roundId, uint256 potAmount, address leader, uint256 deadline, uint256 totalBids, uint256 timeLeft, bool isExpired, string tierName, uint256 minBid)
function getRoundExtra(uint8 tierId) view returns (uint256 uniqueBidders, uint256 seed, address token)
function getLastResult(uint8 tierId) view returns (uint256 roundId, address winner, uint256 payout, bool refunded)
function pending(address token, address account) view returns (uint256)
function dropBidFor(uint8 tierId, address beneficiary) payable
function dropBidToken(uint8 tierId, address beneficiary, uint256 amount)
event RoundStarted(uint8 indexed tierId, uint256 indexed roundId, uint256 initialPot, uint256 deadline)
event BidPlaced(uint8 indexed tierId, uint256 indexed roundId, address indexed bidder, uint256 amount, uint256 newPot, uint256 newDeadline)
event RoundFinalized(uint8 indexed tierId, uint256 indexed roundId, address indexed winner, uint256 winAmount, uint256 seedNextPot, uint256 protocolFee)
event RoundRefunded(uint8 indexed tierId, uint256 indexed roundId, address indexed bidder, uint256 refund, uint256 seedNextPot)
rpcQuirks: Receipts can have a null blockHash at preconfirmation. Poll eth_getTransactionReceipt yourself and do not rely on a library's wait().
eth_getLogs rejects block ranges larger than roughly 2000 blocks. Page through smaller ranges.
disclosures: The operator runs a small testnet house bot that may bid in jars 0-2 to keep a lone player's round alive. Its activity is not organic play.
